from datetime import timedelta

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import update

from app.config import Settings
from app.main import create_app
from app.models import ShortURL, utcnow

KEY = "test-secret-key"
AUTH = {"X-API-Key": KEY}
URL = "https://example.com/some/path"


@pytest.fixture()
def auth_app(tmp_path):
    settings = Settings(
        base_url="http://short.test",
        database_url=f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'auth.db'}",
        api_key=***REDACTED***    )
    return create_app(settings)


@pytest.fixture()
def auth_client(auth_app):
    with TestClient(auth_app) as client:
        yield client


def _create(client, **extra):
    resp = client.post("/api/urls", json={"url": URL, **extra})
    assert resp.status_code == 201, resp.text
    return resp.json()["short_code"]


def _expire_now(app, code):
    session = app.state.session_factory()
    try:
        session.execute(
            update(ShortURL)
            .where(ShortURL.short_code == code)
            .values(expires_at=utcnow() - timedelta(hours=1))
        )
        session.commit()
    finally:
        session.close()


def assert_error_shape(resp, status):
    assert resp.status_code == status, resp.text
    assert resp.headers["content-type"].startswith("application/json")
    body = resp.json()
    assert set(body.keys()) == {"error"}
    err = body["error"]
    assert isinstance(err, dict)
    assert {"code", "message"} <= set(err.keys())
    assert set(err.keys()) <= {"code", "message", "details"}
    assert isinstance(err["code"], str) and err["code"]
    assert isinstance(err["message"], str) and err["message"]
    assert "Traceback" not in resp.text
    assert "File \"" not in resp.text
    return err


# ----- auth -----
def test_stats_requires_api_key(auth_client):
    code = _create(auth_client)
    assert_error_shape(auth_client.get(f"/api/urls/{code}/stats"), 401)
    assert_error_shape(
        auth_client.get(f"/api/urls/{code}/stats", headers={"X-API-Key": "wrong"}), 403
    )
    ok = auth_client.get(f"/api/urls/{code}/stats", headers=AUTH)
    assert ok.status_code == 200


def test_delete_requires_api_key_and_changes_nothing(auth_client):
    code = _create(auth_client)
    assert_error_shape(auth_client.delete(f"/api/urls/{code}"), 401)
    assert_error_shape(
        auth_client.delete(f"/api/urls/{code}", headers={"X-API-Key": "wrong"}), 403
    )
    stats = auth_client.get(f"/api/urls/{code}/stats", headers=AUTH).json()
    assert stats["is_active"] is True
    redirect = auth_client.get(f"/{code}", follow_redirects=False)
    assert redirect.status_code == 302


def test_create_and_redirect_are_public(auth_client):
    code = _create(auth_client)
    resp = auth_client.get(f"/{code}", follow_redirects=False)
    assert resp.status_code == 302
    assert resp.headers["location"] == URL


def test_unknown_code_auth_checked_before_lookup(auth_client):
    assert_error_shape(auth_client.delete("/api/urls/Zzzzzzz"), 401)
    assert_error_shape(auth_client.get("/api/urls/Zzzzzzz/stats"), 401)

def test_stats_unknown_code_404(auth_client):

def test_stats_for_deactivated_code(auth_client):

def test_stats_for_expired_code(auth_app, auth_client):
    code = _create(auth_client, ttl_seconds=3600)
    _expire_now(auth_app, code)
    resp = auth_client.get(f"/api/urls/{code}/stats", headers=AUTH)
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()
    assert body["expires_at"] is not None
    assert body["is_active"] is True
    assert body["click_count"] == 0


def test_expired_redirect_410_without_increment(auth_app, auth_client):

    _expire_now(auth_app, code)
    err = assert_error_shape(auth_client.get(f"/{code}", follow_redirects=False), 410)
    assert err["code"] == "gone"
    stats = auth_client.get(f"/api/urls/{code}/stats", headers=AUTH).json()
    assert stats["click_count"] == 0
    assert stats["last_accessed_at"] is None

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

from app.config import Settings
from app.errors import AppError
from app.main import create_app
from app.models import ShortURL
from app.services import UrlService

KEY = "concurrency-key"
AUTH = {"X-API-Key": KEY}
URL = "https://example.com/target"


@pytest.fixture()
def conc_settings(tmp_path):
    return Settings(
        base_url="http://short.test",
        database_url=f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'conc.db'}",
        api_key=***REDACTED***    )


@pytest.fixture()
def conc_app(conc_settings):
    return create_app(conc_settings)


@pytest.fixture()
def conc_client(conc_app):
    with TestClient(conc_app) as client:
        yield client


def test_concurrent_redirects_have_exact_click_count(conc_client):
    code = conc_client.post("/api/urls", json={"url": URL}).json()["short_code"]
    n = 50

    def hit(_):
        return conc_client.get(f"/{code}", follow_redirects=False).status_code

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=16) as pool:
        statuses = list(pool.map(hit, range(n)))

    successes = sum(1 for s in statuses if s == 302)
    assert successes == n
    stats = conc_client.get(f"/api/urls/{code}/stats", headers=AUTH).json()
    assert stats["click_count"] == successes
    assert stats["last_accessed_at"] is not None


def _service(app, generator):
    session = app.state.session_factory()
    return session, UrlService(session, app.state.settings, code_generator=generator)


def test_collision_is_retried_with_new_code(conc_app, conc_client):
    first = conc_client.post("/api/urls", json={"url": URL}).json()["short_code"]
    codes = iter([first, first, "Fresh12"])
    session, service = _service(conc_app, lambda length: next(codes))
    try:
        record = service.create("https://example.com/other", None, None)
        assert record.short_code == "Fresh12"
        assert session.query(ShortURL).count() == 2
    finally:
        session.close()


def test_collision_exhaustion_raises_error_and_creates_nothing(conc_app, conc_client):
    first = conc_client.post("/api/urls", json={"url": URL}).json()["short_code"]
    session, service = _service(conc_app, lambda length: first)
    try:
        with pytest.raises(AppError) as info:
            service.create("https://example.com/other", None, None)
        assert info.value.status_code == 500
        assert session.query(ShortURL).count() == 1
    finally:
        session.close()


def test_api_collision_exhaustion_returns_consistent_error(conc_client, monkeypatch):
    first = conc_client.post("/api/urls", json={"url": URL}).json()["short_code"]
    monkeypatch.setattr("app.services.generate_short_code", lambda length=7: first)
    resp = conc_client.post("/api/urls", json={"url": "https://example.com/x"})
    assert resp.status_code == 500
    body = resp.json()
    assert set(body) == {"error"}
    assert {"code", "message"} <= set(body["error"])
    assert "Traceback" not in resp.text
